translatorNotes: WISMO handling: the acronym has no Spanish equivalent, so the natural phrase '¿dónde está mi pedido?' is used throughout as the primary rendering. The acronym 'WISMO' is kept where the source leans on it (title, headings, quick-answer capsule, first FAQ) with an inline gloss the first few times ('WISMO, del inglés "Where Is My Order", es decir "¿dónde está mi pedido?"'). English brand/URL slug and the article:section value kept unchanged.
Informal tú used throughout, neutral international Spanish. No em-dashes anywhere; the source's comma-spliced appositive style kept with commas/colons.

Ecommerce glossary: order status -> estado del pedido, support ticket -> ticket de soporte, deflection -> desvío, helpdesk -> servicio de ayuda, carrier -> transportista, fulfillment -> preparación de envíos, self service -> autoservicio. Brand names kept: Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, ShippyPro, eDesk.
